input.claim_summary: CLAIM SUMMARY: Rear-end collision on Route 9 at red light, 8:15 AM yesterday. Claimant (Pat Morgan, POL-1003) stopped at red light when struck by other vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking. Claimant's vehicle totaled—trunk crushed into back seat. Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information documented. Active auto policy with $750 deductible and $100k limit. Estimated total loss well exceeds severity threshold. Third-party liability clearly established. Requires vehicle total loss assessment, medical documentation review, and third-party subrogation coordination.
